text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — pricing packaging change rollout. Need to confirm owners for metering tags, billing mapping, quota enforcement, and contract proration rules. Target milestone: gate on staging by EOW (Fri).
Maria Gonzalez: I can own billing mapping (API->invoice line items). Do we have a canonical schema for plan codes?
Sasha Patel: There is a draft in the metering repo: repo:infra/metering, PR #842. It includes tag keys `plan_code` and `tier_flag`.
Maria Gonzalez: pinging that PR for review then. I need the final list of plan codes from product/legal.
Emma Li: Legal confirmed three contract tiers: Starter, Growth, Enterprise. Enterprise has custom quota windows and no auto-proration on downgrades per SLA. Need to capture that in billing rules.
Chris O'Neill: Quick question on quota resets: if a customer downgrades mid-cycle, do we backfill usage or cap at new tier? For some customers the contract says cap only (no refunds). Need a clear enforcement strategy.
Alex Chen: For implementation, let's enforce caps immediately (no backfills). For pro-rated refunds we need explicit legal sign-off — Emma will confirm.
Emma Li: Confirmed: default is no refund; exceptions handled per legal ops. I'll add exact language to the contract constraints doc and add a list of enterprise accounts with custom terms.
Sasha Patel: Technical note: meter ingestion pipeline tags usage by `customer_id`, `plan_code`, `billing_cycle_start`. If we enforce immediate cap we must evaluate streaming rules so we don't accept tokens beyond cap. Propose adding a policy step in the ingestion hot path that checks `effective_plan` at write time.
Maria Gonzalez: Agreed. For invoice mapping I need the final `plan_code` values and the mapping to invoice SKUs. Can someone post the table?
Alex Chen: Adding the mapping here (draft):
```
plan_code -> invoice_sku
starter_monthly -> SKU-RED-START-M
growth_monthly -> SKU-RED-GROW-M
enterprise_custom -> SKU-RED-ENT-NEG
```
Sasha Patel: I'll add enforcement work item: METER-179 (quota check in hot path), ETA Tue. Also will add integration tests that simulate mid-cycle downgrade.
Chris O'Neill: I'll take test coverage for billing: ensure invoice lines include `proration=false` flag for Enterprise. Will add CI job to run invoice generation against staged metering feed.
billing-bot: Automated notice: nightly-billing-run failed on staging due to missing `plan_code` tag for 2 customers. See job logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/1223
Maria Gonzalez: Noted — I'll audit upstream tagging. If tags are missing we should default to `starter_monthly` with a warning, not fail the run.
Alex Chen: Owners & action items: Maria -> finalize SKU mapping + PR review; Sasha -> implement METER-179 (hot-path quota check) + add tests; Chris -> billing tests & CI; Emma -> finalize contract doc and list of exceptions. Target: all PRs open by Thu COB, staging gate Fri morning. Deploy window Friday 02:00 UTC.
Sasha Patel: I'll paste the hot-path pseudo-code after lunch.
Chris O'Neill: Thx. I'll queue the CI job and tag the billing repo for review.
Emma Li: I'll drop the contract snippets into the legal Google folder and DM the list of exceptions.
Alex Chen: Great. If anything blocks PRs ping me here or @Maria. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Will do, thanks everyone.
Sasha Patel: Quick follow-up: does anyone have a test customer we can use for Enterprise exception flows?
Emma Li: I'll provide three account IDs in the doc.
Alex Chen: Perfect — closing the loop. We'll reconvene async if blockers, otherwise quick post-deploy check-in Fri.
